indication_area: Oncology / immunology (non-Hodgkin lymphoma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, granulomatosis with polyangiitis and microscopic polyangiitis, rheumatoid arthritis; biosimilar to Rituxan)
geography: Worldwide (Pfizer's Worldwide column; almost all U.S.)
formulation: injection for IV infusion, 100 mg/10 mL and 500 mg/50 mL vials

approval_evidence.quote: Application (BLA) : 761103 Company: PFIZER INC ... RUXIENCE RITUXIMAB-PVVR 100MG/10ML(10MG/ML) ... 07/23/2019 ORIG-1 Approval

launch_evidence.quote: Some of the biosimilars that we currently market include Inflectra, Nivestym, Retacrit, Zirabev, Ruxience and Trazimera in the U.S.; Inflectra, Retacrit, Nivestim and Trazimera in the EU; and Ixifi, Trazimera, Zirabev and Ruxience in Japan.

series_start_reason: Pfizer first prints Ruxience in the 2020Q3 release. 2020Q1 (7) and 2020Q2 (11) come from the prior-year columns of the 2021Q1 and 2021Q2 releases. The 2020Q4 release prints the prior-year 2019Q4 as (1), a net negative U.S. figure before any positive sales; the series starts with the first quarter of positive sales, 2020Q1. Launch quarter 2020Q1 is inferred from that and from the 2019 10-K (filed 2020-02-27), which is the first filing to list Ruxience among products Pfizer 'currently market[s]'; the 2020Q3 release credits growth to the 'launches of Ruxience (rituximab), Zirabev (bevacizumab) and Trazimera (trastuzumab) in the U.S.'
series_end_reason: Pfizer's quarterly releases print the line through the 2023Q4 release (8-K 2024-01-30). No release from 2024Q1 (8-K 2024-05-01) through 2026Q3 (8-K 2026-11-03), and no 10-Q or 10-K filed 2024-2026, has a table row starting with Ruxience, Zirabev, Retacrit, Nimenrix or Trumenba (searched; Inflectra and Vyndaqel family rows continue), so 2023Q4 is the last quarter printed on the product's own line.
search_log: Listed every filing for Pfizer (CIK 78003) via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. older 'files' pages; earnings releases = 8-K with item 2.02 filed 2015-06 onward (one per quarter; non-earnings item-2.02 8-Ks of 2016-02-16, 2022-04-20, 2023-10-13 and 2023-12-14 carry no product table), Exhibit 99.1 resolved from each filing's index.json; also fetched every 10-Q/10-K primary document 2015-2026. Searched all of them for table rows starting with Retacrit, Ruxience, Zirabev, Inflectra, Trumenba, Nimenrix, Vyndamax/Vyndaqel.
Rows: first row whose label starts 'Ruxience' (Worldwide table) in each release.
